title: procurement - u.s. embassy in eswatini
paragraphs: welcome to the procurement section of the general services office.  on this page you will be able to find procurement related announcements issued by the embassy of the united states of america in mbabane for the acquisition of commodities and/or services. how to get registered in the embassy’s vendor database the embassy is maintaining a database of prequalified vendors.  interested vendors are encouraged to complete the attached vendor profile form and address the package to the general services officer (gso). vendor profile form (pdf 111 kb) . the usg conducts a security background check on all project personnel.  contractors are required to comply with all local safety & environmental regulations. queries should be sent to mbabaneprocurement@state.gov .

welcome to the procurement section of the general services office.  on this page you will be able to find procurement related announcements issued by the embassy of the united states of america in mbabane for the acquisition of commodities and/or services.
how to get registered in the embassy’s vendor database

the embassy is maintaining a database of prequalified vendors.  interested vendors are encouraged to complete the attached vendor profile form and address the package to the general services officer (gso). vendor profile form (pdf 111 kb) .
